lead: Build your bulk order around the product model, required quantity, artwork and delivery destination. Our factory team coordinates free design, product mockups and the project quotation.
html:
Compare the complete order

Compare quantities and the same product configuration together. A quote for a bare cup and a quote for a cup with a lid, decoration and retail packing cover different supply scopes.

Keep quantity and carton count distinct

Use the product order quantity for purchasing and the packing table for cartons. Some products are supplied as sets; the number of sets is not the same as the number of individual pieces.
